Profile:
Signs Product Range
The scope and range of products available to meet your signage needs is vast. Listed below are just a few of the main product ranges manufactured by Wildan Sign Services Limited. If you see the sign type you are looking for, please do not hesitate to call their sales team who will be more than happy to assist. 

Illuminated Signs 
Wildan produce an extensive range of illuminated fascias ranging from brake press formed aluminium fascias to aluminium sign cases with acrylic panels. Their fascias can be externally illuminated or internally illuminated with either fluorescent tubes or neon, depending on the visual effect required. 

Free Standing Post & Gantry Signs 
Steel fabrication facilities produce steel frameworks for any size of free standing signage from small car park signs to large gantry signage. Their steel work is manufactured to receive a wide range of sign products including cladding panels in order to conceal the underlying structure. 

Three Dimensional (3D) Built Up Lettering 
Built up three dimensional lettering can be constructed from stainless steel, acrylic, aluminium and mild steel depending upon the effect you are trying to achieve. Built up letters can be internally illuminated from the rear to allow light through the letter face or the face can be opaque in order to create a halo effect behind the letter. 

Digital Printing 
This medium is ideal for point of sale, advertising light boxes and In store promotions. Wildan's digital printing products can be used either for exterior or interior display or sign solutions. Many clients now have some form of digital printing on their fascia signs to help the corporate image stand out in the highly competitive high street retail battleground.

Interior Signs  
Directory signs, interior office signs, prestige reception signage, company logos, warehousing identification panels, hanging signs, engravings, health & safety signage, building navigational signage solutions, interior illuminated signs, illuminated poster cases etc.

Neon Signs 
Neon is used widely throughout the sign industry and can either be exposed, encased or even hidden behind solid letters to create halo effects. It is used to outline buildings, to create animation and dynamic lighting just to name a few. The application of neon within the sign and display industry is very varied. 

Projecting Signs 
Used mainly in the high street to supplement a retailer's main fascia. This type of sign, as the name suggests, protrudes from a building, projecting an image when the main fascia is impossible to see. Wildan Signs manufacture all types of projecting signs from traditional wrought iron to aluminium internally illuminated projecting signs. 

Design & Planning  
Designing a sign and planning it's installation can be a complicated process. The sign you want for your business probably has to follow your chosen design or your corporate identity, but it also has to fit your building physically and aesthetically. There are various regulations that may affect it's design, construction, installation and physical location.  Wildan Signs has a proven track record of working closely with clients from the initial concept to the project roll out, providing services that dovetail with client requirements, therefore achieving successful and consistent results. 

CNC Routing Service  
The CNC department provides a routing service to shop fitters, exhibition companies and other sign companies. We rout aluminium, brass, MDF, laminates and plastics to very close tolerances. This allows us to provide a cost effective solution to manufacture inlaid panels as well as routing very complex shapes, the permutations are endless. 

Metal Fabrication & Finishing
Wildan Sign Services' metal fabrication & finishing department has extensive plant investment to enable the in-house manufacture of their wide range of sign and display products. These facilities from guillotining and fabrication to finishing in the spray booth and bake oven ensures they can meet your timescale and quality requirements.

WBDA aims to promote enterprise amongst women and empower them to successfully manage their own businesses.

The success of WBDA is down to the passion and commitment of the staff and how they engage and empathise with their clients.   This success is constantly evaluated by the relevant funding bodies in a systematic and structured way but more importantly WBDA's achievments are measured by the beneficiaries themselves.  This has an added bonus of attracting the women that have been through the process to become trainers and advisers consequently they really understand the issues that effect women in business.

Profile:
The Women's Business Development Agency  (WBDA) was set up in 1990 to promote, support and develop female run businesses.   Today this remains the purpose of the agency with the ultimate aim of encouraging more women into business and nurturing their entrepreneurship.  The all female staff at WBDA provide this service in several ways including; advice, counselling, mentoring, targetted support, in-house and on-line training.

WBDA's achievments and success has been widely recognised as providing a "Flagship" level of service to women business owners by PROWESS, the national women's enterprise support trade association for the past two years running.  In receiving the "Flagship" standard WBDA is one of only six organisations in the UK as acheiving the highest possible levels in all areas.  They are also recognised locally, nationally and internationally to be leaders in their field and proponents of Best Practice.

More recently WBDA has recognised the lack of support for females in high growth occupations such as Science, Engineering and Technology, with few female scientists or innovators setting up their own businesses. WBDA in conjunction with Coventry University are compiling new programmes specifically designed to encourage women new comers and returners into this business area.
